jobs.prompt: Use case: sketch-to-render. Asset type: original painted tactical battle animation sprite. Image 1 is the PRIMARY leg-pose guide; image 2 is identity, equipment and painting-style reference only, NOT the leg pose to repeat. Paint ONE complete full-body character in the exact leg phase below, not a strip. Tunnelmark Bolter: same pale clean-shaven hooded young man, dark charcoal hood and leather coat with silver stitching, ochre neck scarf, fitted grey trousers and strapped brown boots/knee caps. One bolt quiver on belt. Preserve the one small wooden-and-metal crossbow LOADED with one bolt, carried down-right across torso by BOTH hands exactly as reference: near RIGHT hand grips stock/trigger at screen LEFT, far LEFT supports front underneath at screen RIGHT. Preserve its bow limbs, drawn string, rail and stirrup; do not fire it, swap grip, make it gigantic or replace it. Opposite CONTACT: foreground near/right thigh from the camera-near hip beneath the left-screen belt side extends diagonally DOWN-LEFT in front of the other thigh. Near knee and boot are BACK on screen LEFT, heel raised, toe on ground. The distant left leg emerges behind that crossing and extends FORWARD DOWN-RIGHT to heel on ground with toe slightly raised. Do NOT repeat near-leg-forward geometry. Keep two clear hip/knee/boot chains and the foreground-back thigh visibly overlapping the forward-far thigh. Match the reference painterly game style, stable torso size and equipment. Retain near/far limb ownership: blue guide = foreground limbs, orange = far limbs behind. Remove all guide lines/colors/text, leaving real painted anatomy. Square 1536x1536 composition with entire creature, crown/weapons, hair and feet at least 100px inside every edge. Perfectly uniform opaque saturated magenta RGB(255,0,255) everywhere behind and in gaps. Zero magenta reflection/spill on the figure, no checkerboard or simulated transparency. No floor, cast shadow, grid, labels, motion trail, scene, border or second character. This is a new original raster pose, never a rotated or mirrored standing cutout.
jobs.review: Unselected initial gait draft: full-body identity reference dominates guide, contact lead ambiguous/repeated and passing lower leg extends forward like a kick.
